D22_resolution: The tilted-fluid vorticity genuinely depends on vbardot off-shell (this is physics, not the v1.2 bug it was labelled). On-shell (momentum conservation makes the fluid acceleration parallel to v), the spatial vorticity is EOS-independent, orthogonal to u, antisymmetric and vanishes at v=0 -- a well-defined observable. The solver computes it by feeding the RHS's vbardot into h_mu^a h_nu^b nabla_[b u_a].
